_note: Discover → To do, for the cities other than Dubai (lib/guide/cityGuide): each city's own things to do, shown first, then the game-wide ones from activities.json (not the Dubai-only venues and driving). Same item shape as activities.json; 'done' is 'seen' (ticked when you tap Go). href: a map journey (/abu-dhabi?to=<place>, /doha?to=<place>) or a page.

items.title: Fill your Abu Dhabi Passport: AED 15,000 in rewards
items.why: 16 stamps, one at each landmark's signature thing. Rewards at 4, 8, 12 and 16, and the Abu Dhabi Explorer title.

items.title: Tour the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
items.why: The prayer hall's chandelier, the great carpet and the 99 Names on the qibla wall. Modest dress, borrowed free.

items.title: Walk under the Louvre's rain of light
items.why: The 180 m dome and galleries of art from every age.

items.title: Order the gold-flake cappuccino at Emirates Palace
items.why: The palace's famous coffee, dusted with 24-carat gold.

items.title: Ride Formula Rossa, 0 to 240 km/h
items.why: The world's fastest roller coaster, under Ferrari World's red roof.

items.title: Catch a wave at Surf Abu Dhabi
items.why: One of the world's biggest wave pools: lessons for beginners, big waves for the brave.

items.title: Host a yacht party on the Gulf
items.why: A superyacht for three hours, a DJ and lights, and your friends dancing on deck.

items.title: Race a jet ski off Hudayriyat
items.why: Jet skis, flyboards and parasailing over the water.

items.title: Kayak through the mangroves
items.why: Paddle between the roots, with herons and crabs and the towers over the trees.

items.title: Dive for pearls at the Heritage Village
items.why: The way the Gulf's pearls were found, and a sunset dhow cruise on the Corniche.

items.title: Race your car at Yas Marina Circuit
items.why: The Grand Prix circuit: bring your car and race your friends, live.

items.title: Race camels at Al Wathba
items.why: Pick a camel, steer its robot jockey and race your friends.

items.title: Take a quick course: Emirati Arabic
items.why: Fifteen minutes, three lessons and a quiz, and a certificate with charisma experience.

items.title: Take a quick course: solar and clean energy
items.why: How solar works and the UAE's giant solar parks, in fifteen minutes.

items.title: Rent or buy a home in Abu Dhabi
items.where: Al Reem's Shams towers, Al Maryah, Saadiyat, Al Raha, MBZ City…
items.why: Hundreds of flats, villas and townhouses: a home here is home whenever you're in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Check in to a hotel suite
items.where: Emirates Palace, the St. Regis, W Yas and more
items.why: A suite for a night or a week, with room service.

items.title: Go dune bashing in the Liwa desert
items.why: 4x4s over the red dunes, a camel ride and dinner by the fire.

items.title: See the flamingos at Al Wathba
items.why: Thousands of flamingos feeding on the lagoons.

items.title: Hold a falcon at Souq Waqif
items.why: The falcon souq, the spice lanes, oud and gold, and dinner in the old market.

items.title: Visit the Museum of Islamic Art
items.why: I. M. Pei's stacked limestone cubes on their own island, and 1,400 years of art.

items.title: Walk through the National Museum's desert rose
items.why: Qatar's story, from the desert to the pearl divers to today.

items.title: Host a yacht party off The Pearl
items.why: A superyacht for three hours, a DJ and lights, and your friends on deck.

items.title: Jet ski round Gewan Island
items.why: Jet skis, flyboards and parasailing over the lagoon.

items.title: Sail Doha Bay on a dhow at sunset
items.why: An hour round the bay as West Bay's towers light up.

items.title: Kayak the mangroves of Purple Island
items.why: Through the mangroves, where flamingos and herons feed.

items.title: Take a penalty in Lusail Stadium
items.why: The golden bowl of the 2022 World Cup final: tour it and take your shot.

items.title: Ride a gondola through Villaggio
items.why: An Italian village of a mall with a painted sky and a canal.

items.title: Ride the giant indoor coaster at Doha Quest
items.why: A huge indoor theme park inside Doha Oasis.

items.title: Dune-bash to the Inland Sea
items.why: Where the dunes run down into the sea: a 4x4, a swim, a camel ride and dinner.

items.title: Race horses at Al Rayyan
items.why: The Qatar Racing & Equestrian Club's racecourse: pick a horse and race your friends.

items.title: See a concert at the Katara Amphitheatre
items.why: Under the stars, facing the sea, and the blue mosque and pigeon towers next door.

items.title: Take a quick course: Qatar's story
items.why: Pearls, Al Zubarah and independence in fifteen minutes, with a certificate.

items.title: Take a quick course: Arabic calligraphy
items.why: Kufic, Naskh, Thuluth and Diwani, and how to tell them apart.

items.title: Rent or buy a home in Doha
items.where: The Pearl, Lusail, West Bay, Al Mansoura, Al Waab…
items.why: Hundreds of flats, villas and townhouses: a home here is home whenever you're in Doha.

items.title: Check in to a hotel suite
items.where: Katara Towers, the St. Regis, the Mandarin Oriental and more
items.why: A suite for a night or a week, with room service.

items.title: Ride the big wheel at Winter Wonderland
items.why: The fun fair on Al Maha Island: rides, games and food.
